mission: Recover, reuse and independently verify existing computational capabilities for the energy grid; preserve working behaviour and deterministic identity before expansion.

channels.role: show source topology; not proof of executable relationships
existing registered genome, periodic-table, modular and proof-of-work views
existing functional categories; not new identities
render and print same evidence with explicit unknowns and source links
channels.next: Locate actual existing implementation and receiver contract; do not invent or replace it.

gates.rule: No new permanent IDs or name-only equivalence.
No prior passing result transferred to a changed head; cancelled or missing checks remain unresolved.
No real nearest-to-ORIENT composition claim without admitted packages and typed same-dataset lookup.
No redistribution or release without clearance and authority.
No graph colour, printer rendering, catalogue membership or balanced ledger constitutes independent execution proof.

limits: Historical source blobs are observations, not live producer revalidation.
No producer files modified; no automatic cross-repository propagation.
Printer implementation unknown; no fabricated paths or graph edges.
